speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing intense itching and developing red bumps on your thigh and elsewhere; could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have traveled to any areas with mosquitoes or ticks recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies infestation. The intense itching and red bumps appearing on the thigh and other body parts in a 47-year-old male, combined with the mention of a business conference (which implies close contact with others), are classic signs of scabies. I would like to confirm if the itching is worse at night and if anyone in your household has developed similar symptoms. Please also confirm if you have seen any burrows or lines on the skin.
